claims.text: Minnesota Avenue Southeast & 25th Street Southeast had 0 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 0 pedestrians injured, 0 cyclists injured and 0 people killed.
These counts are Minnesota Avenue Southeast & 25th Street Southeast's own: the city's record places 201 of the 208 records within 100 m at another intersection or street, and they are left out.
No crash pattern here stands out against the city's worst crash locations (too few crashes to test).

This corner got Leading Pedestrian Interval signals in 2022. Across the city: at 267 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (-19%, 95% interval -35% to +1%) could be zero. The city's own record neither shows it worked nor rules it out, so repeating it here rests on other evidence.
The city's Leading Pedestrian Interval signals: not shown (at 267 sites the change in pedestrian injury crashes (-19%, 95% interval -35% to +1%) could be zero).

The District Department of Transportation (DDOT) is responsible for 25th Street Southeast, Minnesota Avenue Southeast, Palmer Place Southeast, Pennsylvania Avenue Southeast (no route reference, so presumed a city street).
A request letter to the District Department of Transportation (DDOT) is ready to draft from these facts.
